reason: B offers the more specific and falsifiable mechanism: Cu-rich surface segregation and associated local premelting can be tested directly by correlating temperature-resolved elemental maps with liquid-like structural changes, and it plausibly extends macroscopic Co–Cr–Cu(–Ni) findings to Fe-containing HEA nanoparticles. A relies on an ill-defined claim that annealing selectively reduces chemical disorder—likely also changing segregation, phase state, and defects—so its comparison would not isolate the proposed mediator.
